articles.title: Margaret Demetriou, 76, Longtime Volunteer
articles.deck: Friends remember Margaret Demetriou for the many years of service to Foundry Row.
body: Margaret Demetriou died in August at home on Keystone Street, at the age of 76. Services will be held at the parish hall, and donations may be made to the Hickory Ridge Recreation Center in his or her name.
Survivors include a daughter, two grandchildren and many friends from Foundry Row.
